args.message: I grouped all orders placed in 2025 (408,306 orders, $4,296,716 in sales) by pre-tax value. Under $5 has 60,191 orders and brings in 5.3% of sales. $5 to $10 has 232,467 orders and 32.6%. $10 to $20 has 71,778 orders and 26.0%. $20 or more has 43,870 orders and 36.0%. Each band includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound, so a $10.00 order counts in $10 to $20. Sales and shares are in pre-tax dollars.
